author: hattrill
body:
* **UniProt Keyword ID and label:**
UniProtKB-KW:KW-0436  Ligase

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
* UniProtKB:Q9W2G2
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/annotations?geneProductId=Q9W2G2
 ligase activity

* **Description of issue**
Related to ARBA annotation issue #6180 in that this is probably not an enzyme.
Can see KW2GO annotation in QuickGO/P2GO, but not the KW on the UniProt page (sync issue, perhaps?)

I also came across a ticket from a long time back 
https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/issues/1209 where @ValWood flags up an issue with this KW - but I guess this was fixed.
title: Incorrect UniProt KW mapping: UniProtKB-KW:KW-0436
